blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—President Marcos has signed a new law institutionalizing the Department of Education’s (DepEd) voucher program, allowing eligible Kindergarten to Grade 12 (K to 12) students to enroll in private schools and help decongest public campuses. Deemed a landmark piece of legislation, Marcos signed Republic Act No. 12327, or the Basic Education Voucher Assistance Act, on Nov. 12, but it was released only on Friday. The new law seeks to address the perennial classroom shortage at the basic education level, while expanding access to private schools.
